pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. If G is doh, then B is (1 mark)
   A. me
   B. ray
   C. soh
   D. doh

2. In bubble blowing, you blow bubbles (1 mark)
   A. slowly in the water
   B. with soap
   C. before you enter
   D. on land only

3. In a crab balance, your tummy faces (1 mark)
   A. down
   B. sideways
   C. backwards
   D. up

4. A gourd rattle makes sound because (1 mark)
   A. the seeds inside knock against the walls
   B. strings are plucked
   C. air is blown through it
   D. a bow is rubbed

5. What is a palette? (1 mark)
   A. A frame
   B. A type of paper
   C. A surface for mixing paint
   D. A kind of brush

6. On the colour wheel, orange sits between (1 mark)
   A. red and yellow
   B. blue and green
   C. yellow and blue
   D. red and blue

7. Singing in unison means (1 mark)
   A. everyone sings the same notes at the same time
   B. only one sings
   C. nobody sings
   D. everyone sings different tunes

8. What is the correct way to catch a netball? (1 mark)
   A. With your eyes closed
   B. With one hand held stiff
   C. With your feet
   D. With two hands, giving with the ball

9. In a double-handed catch, where should your eyes be? (1 mark)
   A. On the crowd
   B. On the next player
   C. On the ball until it is in your hands
   D. On the ground

10. Why do we knead clay before using it? (1 mark)
   A. To make it black
   B. To make it hard
   C. To make it dry
   D. To make it smooth and remove air

11. What makes ending on d good for a short melody? (1 mark)
   A. It is the loudest note
   B. It sounds unfinished
   C. It is the highest note
   D. It sounds finished and at rest

12. Which is a way to give good feedback to a partner? (1 mark)
   A. Say one thing that was good and one thing to improve
   B. Say nothing
   C. Push them
   D. Laugh at their mistakes

13. A side roll is also called a (1 mark)
   A. log roll
   B. star roll
   C. frog roll
   D. crab roll

14. In a drawing of a drum with light from the left, which part is darkest? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing is dark
   B. The side away from the light
   C. The white paper background always
   D. The side facing the light

15. A melody is (1 mark)
   A. the tune of a song
   B. the words only
   C. the beat of a drum
   D. the loudness

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. State three occasions when the Kenya National Anthem is sung. (3 marks)

17. Why is colour classification important in painting? (2 marks)

18. State three mistakes in gliding and how to correct them. (3 marks)

19. Where do the notes B, A and G sit on the staff? (3 marks)

20. State four rules for playing the hawk and the chicks game. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — me
   G, A, B match d, r, m.

2. A — slowly in the water
   You put your mouth in the water and blow out slowly.

3. D — up
   The tummy faces the ceiling like a table top.

4. A — the seeds inside knock against the walls
   When shaken, seeds inside hit the gourd and make a sound.

5. C — A surface for mixing paint
   A palette is where paints are mixed.

6. A — red and yellow
   Orange is made from red and yellow, so it sits between them.

7. A — everyone sings the same notes at the same time
   Unison means the same notes together.

8. D — With two hands, giving with the ball
   A double-handed catch with elbows bending as the ball arrives is correct.

9. C — On the ball until it is in your hands
   Watching the ball helps you catch it.

10. D — To make it smooth and remove air
   Kneading makes clay smooth and easy to shape.

11. D — It sounds finished and at rest
   Ending on the home note gives a complete feeling.

12. A — Say one thing that was good and one thing to improve
   Kind and helpful feedback includes praise and a suggestion.

13. A — log roll
   Keeping the body straight like a log gives it the name log roll.

14. B — The side away from the light
   Shadows fall on the side away from the light, so it is darker.

15. A — the tune of a song
   A melody is a series of notes that make a tune.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: School assembly, Madaraka Day, Mashujaa Day, Jamhuri Day, sports events and other official ceremonies. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: It helps us know which colours to mix to get others. It shows that only primary colours are needed to make all the other colours.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Lifting the head: keep it between the arms; bent arms or legs: stretch them; pushing too hard: push gently. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: B is on line 3, A is in the space between line 2 and line 3, and G is on line 2.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: Hold but do not pull; the hawk tags gently; no pushing or tripping; stop at the whistle; take turns. Any four.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
